thread:
zoe (AE): OrionMed POC ask: SAML SSO (IdP + SP), SCIM delta + one-time bulk (~4k users), Okta/Azure support, group->role mapping, tenant partitioning by subdomain (DNS TXT proof), and audit export. They flagged BYOK and extended retention as possible contract terms. Can we align 30m today?

marc (SE): 30m ok. Quick clarifier: do they need encrypted assertions or signed-only? Also, NameID format preference?

tara (Security): From questionnaire: signed assertions required, encryption if PHI present. They want 12-month auth log retention for POC reports (we default 90d). BYOK/HSM will likely require Private. Need SCIM delta history, retry/backoff doc, and proof of tenant via DNS TXT.

ken (Solutions): SCIM mapping snippet to send them: ```json
{"userName":"userPrincipalName","displayName":"name.formatted","groups":"groups","tenant":"extension_orgTenant"}
```

marc (SE): SAML metadata sample to pass to their IdP admin: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://orion.redwood.example/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://orion.redwood.example/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

zoe (AE): Pricing question: will BYOK + 12mo retention force Dedicated/Private? They are hesitant on long commitments.

marc (SE): Short: BYOK (customer-managed keys) + contractual long retention -> usually Private. For POC we can do a hosted demo with temporary elevated retention and a written acknowledgment; guaranteed retention/keys require Private.

tara (Security): Also ask them which IdP vendor and their provisioning cadence (near-real-time vs nightly). If they want mTLS to ACS or IP allowlist for admin UI that's Private-only.

demo-bot: Demo env allocated until 2024-07-20T12:00Z. Request extension via #eng-infra.

zoe (AE): Action items: 1) @marc send SAML metadata + troubleshooting checklist 2) @ken send SCIM mapping + bulk-import steps to procurement 3) @tara mark questionnaire items that force Private 4) I'll schedule pre-call and include IdP admin.

marc (SE): I'll also prepare a short DNS TXT verification example and a basic SAML debug checklist (clock skew, cert thumbprints, NameID mismatch).

zoe (AE): Thanks team. I'll post calendar invite and attach the questionnaire. :white_check_mark:
